k:宣.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) a herald climbs onto the roof (宀) and shouts the news down to the whole waking town. Proclaim (say, announce, speak).
k:宣.hint: Herald on the roof at sunrise.

k:籍.mnemonic: A new farmer is not yet (未) on the village list. He leans his plow (耒) against the hedge (垣) and has his name inked on a bamboo (竹) slip to join the register. Enroll (domiciliary register, membership).
k:籍.hint: Name inked on a bamboo slip.

k:鮮.mnemonic: A fish (魚) still flapping and a sheep (羊) still bleating, both brought to market alive this morning. Nothing on this stall is a day old. Fresh (vivid, clear, brilliant).

k:裏.mnemonic: A garment (衣) split open, with the name of your hometown (里) stitched into the lining, in the middle of the cloth where only the wearer sees it. Amidst (back, reverse, inside).

k:仮.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who is privately anti- (反) everything he says in public. The smile, the title and the promises are all put on for now. Sham (temporary, interim, informal).

k:契.mnemonic: Two chiefs make a deal: one drives a sword (刀) into the soil (土) and a big (大) man stands over it, arms spread, as witness. Whoever breaks his word answers to the sword. Pledge (promise, vow).
k:契.hint: Sword in the soil, big witness.

k:換.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) swap what lies in the cradle (勹): out comes the big (大) kid whose legs (儿) stick out from under the hood (冂), and in goes the newborn. Interchange (change, convert, replace).

k:妹.mnemonic: A woman (女) who is not yet (未) grown: the girl in the family who still has to wait for her turn at everything. Younger sister.
k:妹.hint: The girl still waiting her turn.

k:環.mnemonic: The king (王) has lost his jade band. It slipped off and was caught, like a fish in a net (罒), in a fold of his garment (衣), its round mouth (口) gaping. Ring (circle, loop).
k:環.hint: Jade band caught in the king's robe.

k:希.mnemonic: A castaway ties his one (一) towel (巾) to a leaning pole, a slide (ノ) of driftwood, and waves it at every ship that passes. Maybe this one will stop. Hope (beg, request, pray).
k:希.hint: Castaway waving a towel at ships.

k:抗.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) slam down on the table (几): someone stands up in the meeting, palms flat on the table top, and refuses to back down. Confront (resist, defy, oppose).

k:毒.mnemonic: Mother (母) digs a strange root out of the soil (土) and snatches it away from the children: 'Never eat what grows in this patch!' Poison (virus, venom, germ).
k:毒.hint: Mother snatching away a strange root.

k:湾.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) rolls into a coastline curved like a drawn bow (弓). The water fills the curve and settles there, sheltered on three sides. Gulf (bay, inlet).

k:逆.mnemonic: A sprout (屮) on the path (辶) growing the wrong way up, roots waving in the air and leaves buried in the dirt. Walkers stop and stare. Inverted (reverse, opposite, wicked).
k:逆.hint: Sprout with its roots in the air.

k:練.mnemonic: A dainty (細) dancer goes to the same tree (木) each morning, holds a low branch like a barre and repeats her bend (曲) a hundred times until it is flawless. Practice (train, drill, polish).
k:練.hint: Dancer repeating bends at a tree.

k:払.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) dip into a purse shaped like a cocoon (厶) and flick the coins onto the counter one by one until the purse is cleared out. Pay (clear out, prune, banish).
k:払.hint: Coins flicked from a cocoon purse.

k:善.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) standing over a mouth (口). The gentle sheep never bites, and nothing but kind words come from its mouth. Be as good as the sheep. Virtuous (good, goodness).

k:拡.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) grip both edges of a folded map and pull it wide (広), then wider, until it covers the whole table. Broaden (extend, expand, enlarge).

k:致.mnemonic: At the climax (至) of the old play the hero doth strike (攵) the gong, and the villain is gone (去). The narrator announces every deed in grand old words. Doth (do, send, cause).
k:致.hint: Gong struck at the play's peak.

k:快.mnemonic: A person (人) grabs the handle (ユ) of a big (大) bell and swings from it, heartbeat (忄) racing with delight as it rings out over the town. Cheerful (pleasant, agreeable, comfortable).
k:快.hint: Swinging happily on a big bell.

k:端.mnemonic: You stand (立) at the very rim of the mountain (山) and hold a rake (而) out over the drop to feel where the ground stops. Edge (end, point, border).
k:端.hint: Rake held out over the drop.

k:礼.mnemonic: On the left a small figure at an altar. On the right a single line that drops straight down and then sweeps forward, like a body bending low from the waist. Salute (bow, ceremony, thanks).
k:礼.hint: A line bending low at the waist.

k:熊.mnemonic: An animal with the ability (能) to pad across flames (灬) on its four great paws without flinching: huge, shaggy and afraid of nothing in the forest. Bear.
k:熊.hint: Shaggy beast with paws on flames.

k:筆.mnemonic: A brush (聿) given a handle of bamboo (竹): the hollow stalk grips the hairs, and the tip is dipped in ink to make letters. Writing brush (brush, writing, handwriting).

k:針.mnemonic: A sliver of gold (金) so fine that ten (十) of them fit in a thimble, each with a little cross of thread pulled through its eye. Needle (pin, staple, stinger).
k:針.hint: Ten gold slivers in a thimble.

k:砂.mnemonic: A stone (石) ground down by the waves until only a few (少) specks of it are left in your palm. A whole beach is stone worn down like this. Sand.

k:華.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) heaped tier upon tier on one (一) tall stick (｜), a festival pole so laden with blossom that it lights up the whole street. Splendor (flower, petal, shine).
